日常表达使用轻量模型；可在设置中切换 Hy-MT2。: Switch to Hy-MT2 in Settings for more complex text.

点击图标打开窗口，右键查看菜单。: Click to open the window; right-click for the menu.

默认仅查词。整句翻译需下载模型，选择引擎并保存设置后启用，无需 API Key。: Dictionary only by default. Download a model, select it, and save to enable translation. No API key needed.
默认 · 单词与词组 · 关闭整句翻译: Default · Words and phrases · Sentence translation off
基础整句翻译 · 中英双向 · 按需下载: Basic sentence translation · English ↔ Chinese · Optional download

CPU 本地运行，推荐至少 8 GB 内存。模型约 1.13 GB，首次使用需要: Runs locally on CPU. 8 GB RAM recommended. Download or import the official ~1.13 GB GGUF model before use.
